It’s past 1:00 PM, and everyone fears Popatlal has missed the auspicious time for his Mahashivratri temple puja. However, when Daya calls Vanveer Baba, he clarifies that Lord Shiva can be worshipped at any time, lifting everyone's spirits.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
